notes: Printing from other PCs: Settings → This Computer → Printer Settings now lets each other PC choose for EACH paper where it prints — 🖨 here (print window, this PC's printer) or 🖥 on the main PC's printer (no window). Covers sales invoice/proforma, bag stickers, envelope and every marketing paper (sample stickers, cover letter, address label, envelope, declarations, local freight letter, quick sticker, letters). Buttons: All here / All on the main PC.
